title: Six-Day War
summary: A brief war between Israel and Egypt, Syria and Jordan, begun by an Israeli preemptive air assault after weeks of escalating tension. Israel captured the Sinai Peninsula, Gaza Strip, West Bank, East Jerusalem and Golan Heights. The status of these territories became a central issue in the Arab-Israeli conflict, and UN Resolution 242 followed.
